## Unparented

### Phase 17: Hierarchical anchored speed preset

`proposed` · `@jpegxl-rs.work.arch-phase17-quality-speed-preset/1`

Reduce equivalent-quality rate-loop multiplicity by screening a measured hierarchical anchored speed preset. Balanced keeps the configured hierarchical cover, CfL, and trailing quantizer, reuses one structural anchor across bounded navigation/final probes, and uses fast entropy for the anchored finalist; Quality remains the exhaustive full-entropy reference and Fast remains the relaxed fixed-cover tier. Retain only if Balanced stays target-safe, decodable, deterministic, and perceptually near Quality while materially reducing time; otherwise record the negative result.
